Partners.title: CRM & multi-posting partners
Partners.intro: Connect Softreal, Urbium, backOFFICE, RealSys and other CRM exports so thousands of listings sync to Nunvio automatically — starting in Slovakia & Czechia, then the rest of Europe.
Partners.how1: Expose a stable HTTPS XML feed (one URL per agency or per CRM export).
Partners.how2: Agency registers on Nunvio and pastes the Feed URL under Dashboard → XML import.
Partners.how3: Enable automatic sync — Nunvio pulls in chunks every ~15 minutes (safe for large catalogs).
Partners.how4: Listings upsert by externalId — updates do not create duplicates.
Partners.crmBody: CRM / multi-posting vendors add Nunvio as an export destination. Agencies can also paste their existing XML URL directly. We do not buy catalog dumps from competing portals.
Partners.techSync: Chunked cron sync, R2 image import, SK/CZ field aliases (nazov, popis, cena, obec…).
Partners.contactBody: For bridge setup or a test agency account, email

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: placeholder — to be confirmed by the operator.
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Nunvio processes personal data when you use our real estate platform. It is drafted with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in mind and is provided as an operational placeholder until final legal review.
Privacy.controllerBody: The data controller for Nunvio is the operating company that publishes this service. Full legal identity (company name, registered address, company registration / IČO, and contact email) will be completed by the operator before production launch.
Privacy.companyPlaceholder: Company details (legal name, IČO / registration number, registered address, and privacy contact) will be filled in by the operator.
Privacy.dataBody: Depending on how you use Nunvio, we may process account data (name, email, password hash), listing content you submit, inquiry messages, technical logs (IP address, device/browser metadata), and payment-related identifiers handled via our payment provider when promotions or paid features are used.
Privacy.purposeBody: We process data to provide and secure the service, create and manage accounts, display listings, facilitate contact between interested parties and advertisers, send transactional emails (verification, password reset), improve reliability, and comply with legal obligations. Legal bases may include contract performance, legitimate interests (security and service improvement), and consent where required.
Privacy.rightsBody: Under GDPR you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection to certain processing, and you may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. Identity verification may be required before we fulfil a request.
Privacy.retentionBody: We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law. Where processors or hosting providers are used, we seek appropriate contractual safeguards. If data is transferred outside the EEA, we rely on an adequacy decision or other lawful transfer mechanism.
Privacy.contactBody: For privacy requests, contact the operator using the privacy email published once company details are completed. Until then, treat this page as a non-binding placeholder policy.

Terms.accountsBody: You must provide accurate information, keep credentials confidential, and use the platform lawfully. You may not upload unlawful content, scrape the service in an abusive way, attempt unauthorised access, or misuse contact channels for spam or fraud.
Terms.listingsBody: Advertisers are responsible for the accuracy, legality, and rights clearance of listing text, photos, pricing, and contact details. By publishing content you grant Nunvio a non-exclusive licence to host, display, and promote that content within the service.
Terms.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by applicable consumer and commercial law, Nunvio is provided on an “as is” basis. We are not liable for disputes between users, offline transactions, or third-party websites linked from listings. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under mandatory EU or member-state law.
Terms.lawBody: These terms are intended to be governed by the laws of the EU member state where the operating company is established, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections in your country of residence. Venue and company identity will be confirmed once registration details are filled in.
